content:
Evan Torres: Heads-up  new deal with NovaHosp IT: they want an on-prem air-gapped POC. Questions: how we do signed minibundles, upgrade cadence (policy is monthly but they want a quarterly baseline + emergency patch path), whether we can support their HSM, and any sealed-environment surcharge. They attached a 28Q security questionnaire.

Mira Shah: Quick clarifiers: 1) Transport: courier USB vs encrypted SD? 2) Minibundle size limit? (logistics team prefers <200MB) 3) Do they want us to sign for POC or self-sign?

Evan Torres: For POC they'll accept our signing and couriered USBs. Long-term they prefer self-signing tooling. Max per-bundle target 200MB.

Caleb Wong: Tech notes: we can produce signed delta bundles and a Notary v2 manifest. For airgap we support BYO-HSM via KMIP; if they want us to hold keys for POC we need an HSM custody addendum. Emergency CVE path: we can deliver a signed hotfix bundle via courier within 48-72h under an SLA. Estimated artifact delivery if requirements locked: 10 business days.

Sofia (Security): Security constraints: telemetry disabled by default; provide SBOM + signed attestations per release; pen tests allowed with NDA and scoped window. Need to confirm retention (we can keep manifests 5y default). Also ask legal if courier chain-of-custody docs are needed.

Taya (Solutions): Commercial sketch: one-time POC packaging/signing: $8,000; POC eng/support (2 weeks): $3,000; emergency hotfix SLA addendum: $3,500; ongoing sealed-env support: $1,800/mo; HSM custody/physical courier handling: $4,500 one-time. Provisional until we confirm transport and retention.

Evan Torres: Please draft a short SOW skeleton and an SQ checklist I can send to their procurement. I also need a one-page Notary verification explainer for their infra team.

Mira Shah: I'll draft SOW + checklist. Checklist items to confirm with NovaHosp: transport preference, max minibundle size, signing preference (us vs self), contact for security lead, retention period for manifests, need for courier chain docs, and reproducible build requirement.

Caleb Wong: If they accept courier + our signing and no runtime custom patches during build window, 10 business day ETA stands. If they want BYO-HSM onboarding, add 3-5 business days.

deploy-bot: Meeting created "NovaHosp airgap POC kickoff" Apr 12 11:00 PT. Invites sent. :calendar:

Evan Torres: Thanks team. I'll send initial SQ answers today and post updates here. :thumbsup:
